title: Configuration Adjacency Formula
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $C,n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. The configuration-adjacency CNF is obtained by concatenating the input-equality CNF with the transition CNF, then relabelling its variables by the specified pairing of wires.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
caveat: The input-equality CNF and wire-pairing map are referenced but not defined in the supplied snippet.
